symbols.name: select_best
symbols.note: Public method on a class (presumably EvolutionEngine). Filters candidates by completed, no error, and score >= 100.0; returns highest-scoring or None.

claims.text: A hung candidate is a FAILED candidate, never an unscored one left to block the gather. Kill it and say why.
claims.why: On TimeoutError, candidate.score is set to 0.0, error message is set, process.kill() is called, and process.wait() is awaited. The gather will not hang because the task completes with exception caught.

claims.text: Selects the best candidate based on the score.
claims.why: The function filters candidates with score >= 100.0 and sorts by score descending, returning the first (highest score) or None.
FileNotFoundError is caught and candidate.error is set to 'pytest not found'.

observations.what: The evaluate_single function is defined inside a method (likely evaluate) and uses async subprocess to run pytest. It handles returncode 0 as success (score 100), else score 0 with error output.
select_best requires score >= 100.0; scoring is binary (0 or 100) in evaluate_single, so this works. But if scoring logic changes, select_best may need adjustment.

The evaluate method catches exceptions from asyncio.gather and logs them, but does not re-raise; any exception in gather causes the whole evaluation to be logged but candidates may be left in inconsistent state.
